paragraphs: An outbreak of E. coli O145 linked to frozen blueberries is now over [1]. The outbreak affected 17 people across two states, resulting in six hospitalizations and no deaths [1].

Gias Foods is recalling bettergoods Authentic Italian Lemon Alfredo Fettuccine sold at Walmart due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [6][25]. So Delicious Dairy Free Salted Caramel Cluster Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert pints with best-by dates on or before April 3, 2028 are being recalled for potential foreign material [5]. Saratoga Potato Chips is recalling 7.75-ounce packages of J. HIGGS Loaded Bacon and Cheddar Potato Chips because they may contain undeclared soy allergen [4][17]. GF Blends is recalling Truly AIP All Purpose Flour and Bread Mix and EAT G.A.N.G.S.T.E.R. Flat Bread Pizza Mix due to potential undeclared wheat gluten [2]. A&P Creations LLC is recalling biQ-FEL nationwide because it contains undeclared sildenafil and tadalafil, active ingredients in prescription drugs [8].
